import pytest


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Print a log line formatted as `[level] message` to stdout.

    Console output only: must not read or write any files.
    """
    print(f"[{level}] {message}")


def test_basic_format(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "started")
    out = capsys.readouterr()
    assert out.out == "[INFO] started\n"
    assert out.err == ""


def test_level_not_altered(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("warn", "disk low")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[warn] disk low\n"


def test_empty_message(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("DEBUG", "")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[DEBUG] \n"


def test_empty_level(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("", "hello")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[] hello\n"


def test_message_with_brackets_and_unicode(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    log_line("ERROR", "bad [value] ✗")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[ERROR] bad [value] ✗\n"


def test_prints_exactly_one_line(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "x")
    out = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert out.count("\n") == 1
    assert out.endswith("\n")


def test_does_not_touch_filesystem(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    import builtins
    import io
    import pathlib

    def forbidden(*args: object, **kwargs: object) -> None:
        raise AssertionError("log_line must not touch the file system")

    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "open", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(io, "open", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(pathlib.Path, "open", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(pathlib.Path, "write_text", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(pathlib.Path, "write_bytes", forbidden)

    log_line("INFO", "console only")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] console only\n"
